task_description: Phase 2 of the MyKhata 2.0 UX redesign (branch redesign/mykhata-2.0): (1) collapse optional add-transaction fields behind an 'Add details' disclosure, (2) route SMS single-confirm through the shared add form via an optional prefill, (3) SMS batch 'Add all N high-confidence', (4) Transactions quick-filter chips + verify per-day totals, (5) swipe-right quick-edit on history rows, (6) unify Budgets/Insights time-range control styling. Reuse existing design system; no token/nav changes; all existing tests must pass. No worktree, no push.
